title: VP Sara Duterte confirms requesting anew to visit father at ICC detention
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte confirmed on Sunday that she has filed another request with the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow her visit her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, in…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte confirmed on Sunday that she has filed another request with the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow her visit her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, in December.
In a Super Radyo dzBB report of Sam Nielsen, Duterte announced her recent request to the high tribunal during a gathering with overseas Filipino workers in Hong Kong.
Duterte said she is hopeful that the ICC will allow her to visit the former president who's currently detained in The Hague, Netherlands.
Rodrigo Duterte is currently facing crimes against humanity case at the ICC. His trial is set to start on November 30, 2026. — BAP, GMA News
